name: Echoes of Baikal
source:
A journey with your father to Lake Baikal, where a storm and an old photo album revive memories of family, loss, and reconciliation.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967480/Echoes_of_Baikal/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与父亲一起前往贝加尔湖，一场暴风雨和一本旧相册唤起了人们对家庭、失落与和解的记忆。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967480/Echoes_of_Baikal/]Steam[/url]]
